    Rescaling arrows and mesh relations #

    That paper and Appendix A: "rescaling arrows and entire mesh relations changes the mesh derivative by invertible diagonal maps". Given arrow scalars μ and relation scalars η with c'_{x,a} = η_x c_{x,a} μ_{σ a} μ_a, the linear functor kQ → kQ multiplying each path by the product of the scalars of its arrows (gaugeMap) sends the mesh relation r_x(c) to η_x⁻¹ r_x(c'), hence the mesh ideal of c into that of c' (gaugeMap_mem_ideal). A single path therefore lies in one ideal iff it lies in the other.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
